Ultra-wide, street-level view of the Lunar Obelisk, a colossal, multi-tiered skyscraper on the moon's desolate, cratered surface. The camera is positioned slightly elevated (25-30° downward tilt), capturing the immense building at a slight angle to emphasize its overwhelming scale and depth. The foreground features the cracked, dusty lunar regolith, with subtle variations in texture and sharp, absolute shadows cast by the harsh, direct sunlight. In the midground, the Lunar Obelisk itself is the primary subject, a single, massive, vertical structure with stark, geometric lines and a rectilinear, tiered base tapering to a sharp apex. Its facade is an impossibly smooth, obsidian-like material, reflecting the ambient starlight and sunlight with a polished, almost liquid-like sheen. Narrow, vertical window slits punctuate the dark surface, appearing as sharp white light against the deep black. The building is positioned slightly off-center, creating an asymmetric composition with more of the alien landscape visible on one side. In the background, the star-filled lunar sky stretches out, a canvas of deep blacks and obsidian tones with faint reflections of distant stars. The atmosphere is one of absolute silence and profound desolation, with no visible motion except for the slow drift of stars. The architectural tone is strictly futuristic minimalist monolithic, with a cultural tone of alien, ancient, and unknown purpose. The color palette is dominated by deep black (90%), with starfield reflections (8%) and sharp white light accents (2%).


[FILTER: NoLivingSubjects] DON'T INCLUDE:
[NEG:] humans, people, faces, characters, animals, creatures, silhouettes, bodies, watermark, signature.


crisp micro-detail, refined surfaces, natural texture, balanced high dynamic range, soft highlight bloom, controlled contrast, subtle volumetric light, smooth bokeh, rich color separation, gentle halation, mild cohesive grain

Interior of a massive, rectangular-tiered, futuristic-minimalist obelisk. The space is vast, stark, and towering, with sharp, geometric chambers. Walls, floor, and ceiling are clad in impossibly smooth, perfectly polished, obsidian-like material, reflecting dim, sharp-edged starlight and the pale light of distant Earth. Absolute black dominates (90%), with starfield reflections (8%) and sharp white light accents (2%). Shadows are profound and absolute. A monolithic plinth stands at the center, with a holographic star chart projector hovering above it. Crystalline data terminals are embedded into the walls, and subtle, ethereal light emitters cast a cool, alien glow. A recessed portal is visible on the front wall, a glowing energy conduit runs along the left wall, a subtle hatch is set into the floor, and a hidden alcove is suggested on the right wall. The atmosphere is one of profound silence, desolation, and immense, ancient purpose. The mood evokes awe, mystery, and isolation. Asymmetric composition, emphasizing verticality and the overwhelming scale.
